mapper.select: SELECT ast06_tr_id AS tr_id , ast06_ast_class_tree_id AS ast_class_tree_id , ast06_date AS date , ast06_tr_cd AS tr_code , ast06_cur_cd AS cur_code , ast06_fx_rate AS fx_rate , ast06_amt AS amt , ast06_for_amt AS for_amt , ast06_person_id AS person_id , ast06_pur_tr_id AS pur_tr_id , ast06_company_id AS company_id , ast06_pur_date AS pur_date , ast06_book_amt AS book_amt , ast06_acm_depn_cost AS acm_depn_cost , ast06_depn_cost AS depn_cost , ast06_item_class_type_nm AS item_class_type_name , ast06_class_tree_nm AS class_tree_name , ast06_depn_year AS depn_year , ast06_depn_rt AS depn_rate , ast06_depn_type AS depn_type , ast06_depn_type_nm AS depn_type_name , ast06_status_nm AS status_name , ast06_journal_id AS journal_id , ast06_non_deduct_tax AS non_deduct_tax , ast06_calc_start_date AS calc_start_date FROM ( SELECT COALESCE(ast06_tr_id, f_create_seq()) AS ast06_tr_id , ast13_ast_class_tree_id AS ast06_ast_class_tree_id , #{depnDate}::date AS ast06_date , '5012' AS ast06_tr_cd , 'KRW' AS ast06_cur_cd , 1 AS ast06_fx_rate , COALESCE(ast06_amt , 0) AS ast06_amt , COALESCE(ast06_for_amt, 0) AS ast06_for_amt , ast06_person_id AS ast06_person_id , ast13_pur_tr_id AS ast06_pur_tr_id , ast13_company_id AS ast06_company_id , ast13_pur_date AS ast06_pur_date , ast13_pur_amt AS ast06_book_amt , ast13_acm_depn_cost AS ast06_acm_depn_cost , ast13_depn_cost AS ast06_depn_cost , f_cdnm('ItemLClassCode', ast01_item_l_class_cd, ast13_company_id, ast13_pur_date) ||'-'||f_cdnm('ItemMClassCode', ast01_item_m_class_cd, ast13_company_id, ast13_pur_date) ||CASE WHEN substr(ast01_item_s_class_cd,5) = '99' THEN '' ELSE '-'||f_cdnm('ItemSClassCode', ast01_item_s_class_cd, ast13_company_id, ast13_pur_date) END ast06_item_class_type_nm , ast01_class_tree_nm AS ast06_class_tree_nm , ast01_depn_year AS ast06_depn_year , ast01_depn_rt AS ast06_depn_rt , ast01_depn_type AS ast06_depn_type , f_cdnm('DepnType', ast01_depn_type, ast01_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS ast06_depn_type_nm , CASE WHEN ast06_tr_id IS NULL THEN '미처리' ELSE '처리완료' END AS ast06_status_nm , ( SELECT act02_journal_id FROM act02_journal WHERE act02_tr_id = ast06_tr_id ) AS ast06_journal_id , COALESCE(( SELECT ast16_apply_non_deduct_tax FROM ast16_non_deduct_tax WHERE ast16_pur_tr_id = ast13_pur_tr_id AND ast16_apply_date <= #{depnDate}::date ORDER BY ast16_apply_date DESC LIMIT 1 ),0) AS ast06_non_deduct_tax , CASE WHEN (ast13_pur_date = ast13_depn_date AND COALESCE(ast13_depn_cost,0) = 0 ) THEN ast13_depn_date ELSE (ast13_depn_date + interval '1month')::date END AS ast06_calc_start_date , ast13_pur_amt - COALESCE(ast13_acm_depn_cost,0) AS rem_depn_cost FROM ast13_book_depn INNER JOIN ast01_class_tree ON ( ast01_class_tree_id = ast13_ast_class_tree_id AND ast01_depn_type IS NOT NULL ) LEFT OUTER JOIN ast06_tr ON ( ast06_company_id = ast13_company_id AND ast06_pur_tr_id = ast13_pur_tr_id AND ast06_date = #{depnDate}::date AND ast06_tr_cd = '5012' ) -- (5012:감가상각) WHERE ast13_company_id = #{companyId} AND COALESCE(ast13_retire_date,'9999-12-31') > #{depnDate}::date AND (ast13_pur_tr_id, ast13_depn_date) IN ( SELECT ast13_pur_tr_id, MAX(ast13_depn_date) FROM ast13_book_depn WHERE ast13_company_id = #{companyId} AND ast13_depn_date <= #{depnDate}::date GROUP BY ast13_pur_tr_id ) ) t WHERE ( ( ast06_status_nm = '미처리' AND rem_depn_cost + ast06_non_deduct_tax > 1000 ) OR ( ast06_status_nm != '미처리' ) ) ORDER BY ast06_item_class_type_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8" DESC, ast06_pur_date, ast06_pur_tr_id
SELECT count(*) FROM ast06_tr WHERE ast06_tr_id = #{trId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ast06_tr (ast06_tr_id, ast06_company_id, ast06_ast_class_tree_id, ast06_date, ast06_tr_cd, ast06_amt, ast06_person_id, ast06_cur_cd, ast06_for_amt, ast06_fx_rate, ast06_pur_tr_id, ast06_book_amt) VALUES (#{r.trId}, #{companyId}, #{r.astClassTreeId}, #{r.date}, '5012', #{amt}, #{personId}, 'KRW', #{amt}, 1, #{r.purTrId}, #{r.bookAmt})
mapper.select: SELECT ast16_non_deduct_tax_id AS non_deduct_tax_id , ast16_pur_tr_id AS pur_tr_id , ast16_apply_date AS apply_date , ast16_apply_non_deduct_tax AS apply_non_deduct_tax , ast16_note AS note FROM ast16_non_deduct_tax WHERE ast16_pur_tr_id = #{purTrId} ORDER BY ast16_apply_date
